…I shake my head.

The Three Corpses——the worms said to inhabit the human body and report their host's wicked deeds to the king of Hell.

I've heard of those, but never of Crest Worms.

…I shake my head.
Sanshi
a bug said to inhabit a human body that reports the person’s evil deeds to the Judge of Hell.
I’ve heard of sanshi, but I’ve never heard of a crest worm.

“No? In their ordinary form, they are harmless parasites.

“They are familiars that survive by feeding on their host's magical energy. They do nothing but signal that their host remains alive—the lowest possible order of familiar.”

“So you do not know. Well, it was originally just a harmless parasite.
It’s a familiar that lives off of its host’s magical energy. It is of the lowest rank of familiars, as it does nothing beyond telling its master whether or not its host still lives.”

“……I see. So it’s like a monitoring device.
So Zouken’s monitoring Sakura with that?”
“Oh. When was it decided that Matou Zouken is the master of the crest worm?”

I’m sorry, but I’m in no mood for your long talk. Who else but that old bastard would do something like that to Sakura?”
“I see, that is certainly true. Matou Shinji cannot use crest worms. So it can only be that vampire.”

You are being hasty, Rin. You seem to understand her condition, but the boy does not. We should explain for his sake, right?”
“……!”
Tohsaka looks away awkwardly.
Judging by her expression, she doesn’t want me to find out.

“Well, Shirou Emiya? Rin wishes to hear only the conclusion.”

pages.mirrorMoon:
“Well, what shall we do, Emiya Shirou? Rin says she just wants to know the result.”

…I feel guilty toward Tohsaka.

…I’m sorry for Tohsaka.

pages.en:
“Then I shall continue.

“The Crest Worms I described have eaten into Sakura Matou's nervous system.

“That is the result of eleven years spent growing inside her body. The worms have become nerves resembling Magic Circuits, spreading throughout her body as they entwine themselves with the nerves she was born with.

“The structures that have developed from those Crest Worms into a Magic Crest ordinarily lie dormant and exert no influence upon her.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Then let me continue.
The crest worm I explained earlier is undermining Matou Sakura’s nerves.
It must be the result of eleven years spent growing within her. The crest worm has turned into a nerve, like a Magic Circuit, and it has entangled with her own, swarming all throughout her body.
It has transformed into her Magic Crest. Under normal circumstances it is suspended, having no effect on Matou Sakura’s body.”

pages.en:
“But once activated, they invade Sakura Matou's nerves and continue moving, feeding upon her magical energy.

“That was what you witnessed earlier. The Crest Worms roamed through her body and stole away the magical energy that sustains her life.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But once activated, it will violate Matou Sakura’s nerves and will keep moving using her magical energy.
That’s what happened earlier. The crest worm roamed through her body, absorbing her magical energy.”

動力である魔力を吸い尽くした刻印虫は、更なる栄養として間桐桜自身を狙う。魔力を空にされた間桐桜は、次にその身体を刻印に奪われるという事だ」

The crest worm would suck all of her magical energy as its power, then
eat her flesh
aim for her body
as nutrition. It means she would have her body consumed after her magical energy was sucked dry.”

pages.en:
“You possess a Magic Crest, so you should understand the magnitude of that pain.

“The human body protests at a foreign object no larger than a fingernail, sometimes so violently that life itself is impaired. Imagine alien nerves threaded through every part of your own, and then imagine the revulsion when those nerves begin to move. The nausea alone might be enough to kill.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“If you have a Magic Crest, you should well know how painful it is.
Even the faintest trace of a foreign substance puts a human body through discomfort, and can even be life-threatening. Having another creature entwining its nerves with your own, moving within you, would easily be enough to kill you.”

“…Seen in that light, it is remarkable that Sakura Matou remained conscious until only a short while ago.

“……In that regard, I’m surprised Matou Sakura was conscious until just now.
I do not know if Matou Sakura has a strong will, or if she is just used to the crest worm’s activation. We will need to ask her if we want this answered.”
